label: My Friend, and My Friend Alone

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: We've received confirmation that the Raptures have been terminated.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: There is only one objective remaining, which is to destroy the freight elevator.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: Also, I must inform you that the sealing date for the Ark has been delayed for an additional 3 weeks.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I presume the delays are due to all of these issues on the surface?

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: I'm sorry, but can you handle 3 more weeks where you are?

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: We will send supplies to your next objective, the freight elevator.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: It will be a full month's supply. Will you be able to get by in the meantime?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We'll make it work.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: With how things are, waiting another 3 weeks will not be a major issue.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: All right, thank you.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: I will send the supplies immediately.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: After you receive the shipment, destroy the elevator.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Roger. Will communications stay up afterwards?

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Okay. I will contact you once the work is done.

lines.speaker: manvoice
lines.text: I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: collectrobot
lines.text: *Beep*

lines.speaker: collectrobot
lines.text: Communication ended.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Additional supplies!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Does that mean we don't need to go out scrounging for our own supplies?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: We can concentrate more on guarding this area.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: To be honest though, there haven't been that many raids lately.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We should move out pronto. Where's Snow White?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: She's off scavenging. Should be back soon.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Here I am.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Welcome back.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Did you find anything?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I caught a deer.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Again? Do you have something against deer?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 'Tis most unfortunate that none amongst us knows how to skin this ungulate properly.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Skin this deer for me, will you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Will do.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You know how to skin that thing, Dorothy?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Of course I do. How hard can it be?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All you've got to do is follow the proper steps.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Go ahead.
1 hour later.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That should do it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hehe, that wasn't as hard as I thought it'd be.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Incredible. Teach me next time.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'm... not... feeling well...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's smoke it and preserve it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'll leave that to you, Scarlet.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Very well. Can we take some of the meat and roast it as well?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Shouldn't be a problem.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Then let's go, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Oh right, Snow White.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Thank you for helping me out before.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Don't mention it. I simply did what I had to.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Did you sleep after that?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: If you keep doing that...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Don't worry about me. I'll never lose touch with my humanity.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yeah?
Snow White stares at Dorothy intently.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Why are you looking at us like that?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Why do you keep saying "us"?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: You're the only one here.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: What are you seeing?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I don't know what you're saying.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Forgive me, but I asked Rapunzel and Scarlet to keep tabs on you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: They informed me that it was sometimes difficult to carry on a conversation with you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: They said it was as if you were speaking to someone else.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Huh? That's obviously...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: ... Is Pinne with you now?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: She's been here the whole time.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: My spirits are high.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Communication with the Ark has been reached. They didn't forget about us, and they've prepared a grand homecoming for us.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We can go to Paradise.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: The Ark... how exciting! I doubt I'll be able to get any sleep tonight.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Haha, me neither.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I must admit, I am rather looking forward to it myself.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: It's our first time coming out this far. Before we were restricted to that small area right outside the Ark's entryway.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Isn't this exciting?!

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Super exciting.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: It's great being able to venture out this far.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How about we have a little fun?

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Is that okay? The other will be waiting.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I don't see any problem with it. After all, it's not every day we get to do this kind of thing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It's nice to see you're in such high spirits.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We are still alive and breathing.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And we're going to keep it that way.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All of us. Together in paradise.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do you remember? We promised each other.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Yes, I remember, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I remember.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Is that... a grave?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We can't go there. There are Raptures in that area.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Who cares? Let's go.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: There's only a handful of them. I can handle them on my own if I have to.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Is there any way to lure them over in this direction?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Are you worried that they'll desecrate the graves?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Yes. But it's too much of a hassle, we don't have to do it.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Fire your gun off into the air.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hmm... that's a good idea.
*Tang*

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How's that for luring them over?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... A little over-the-top, don't you think?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Never thought I'd hear you accuse me of that.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Not exactly subtle, but effective.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It's coming!

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Here they come!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Just stand and watch me work.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I don't see Snow White. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Oh, that...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: She's on the lookout.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... She's incorrigible.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Do not fret. She would let it be known if she was truly fatigued.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: No, she wouldn't. That's the problem.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Are you going to go looking for her?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Forget it. I'm not chasing after her.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: She'll just talk her way out of it again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Haha, she is truly a most inveterate individual.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Is it just me, or have you seemed inordinately strong lately? More so than usual.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What do you think is different?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Perhaps it is because I am cheating, haha.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Cheating?

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Do you think she's colluding with the Raptures?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Haha, come on, be serious.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Skin this deer for me, will you?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Will do.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You know how to skin that thing, Dorothy?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Of course I do. How hard can it be?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: All you've got to do is follow the proper steps.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: That's right. It's easy as pie.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: That should do it.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: That's it. Nicely done.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hehe, that wasn't as hard as I thought it'd be.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Incredible. Teach me next time.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You okay, Snow White? You look like you've seen a ghost.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Pinne is dead.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: She was corrupted. You put her down yourself.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Whatever this... thing is inside of you, it's just a made-up...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Ahaha.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Never thought I'd see the day when you were cracking jokes, Snow White.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You went a little over the line with that last wisecrack, but that's okay.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You can keep working on it.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Still, I can tell you put some real effort into it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Definitely. Doesn't it seem to you like Snow White is different?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: We can't let her get the last laugh. We've gotta come up with a joke of our own.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: Okie-dokie! What's our joke gonna be?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Not sure. The main thing is that it's gotta be something creative, something out of the ordinary.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: How about we both brainstorm individually, and whoever can't come up with something has to prepare the other's meals for the next 5 days.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Sounds good! I've got this in the bag.

lines.speaker: pinne
lines.text: I take it that means you're taking the bet?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You're on! Let's pinky swear on it.
Dorothy does a pinky swear in mid-air.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Wow, it's been a while since I did one of those.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: ... Dorothy.
